title: Demographic Characteristics of Children Suffering From Mental Retardation or Cerebral Palsy in the Israeli Arab Community
brief_summary: To evaluate the demographic characteristics of patients suffering from mental retardation or cerebral palsy in the Israeli Arab community. Specific questionnaires will be developed and will be distributed amongst this population in order to identify these characteristics.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* cerebral palsy
* mental retardation
* Israeli Arab
* Israeli Jewish

Exclusion Criteria:

* all others
study_population: Israeli Arab and Israeli Jewsih children suffering from mental retardation or cerebral palsy who have presented at the Child Development Institute at the Hillel Yaffe Medical Center.
